probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Nordhavn Overview Buy Ella Mae Pilot Crew Ferry Models Pilot Crew Ferry Company About Team Investors Careers Media News Events Owners Service Charging Customer stories Contact Battery systems engineer Own the battery packs on the Pilot and the Crew, from cell choice and cooling to the software that keeps a boat running a full shift. Team Engineering Contract Full time Location Waalhaven yard, Rotterdam Salary €64,000 to €78,000 Apply for this role Posted 28 September 2026 Recruiting [email protected] The role Every Nordhavn boat runs on packs we design and assemble at the yard. You will own them across the Pilot and the Crew: cell choice, cooling, the battery management software and the tests that prove a pack will last ten years of daily charging at the quay. You will work next to the people who build the boats, so a question about a busbar is a walk across the hall, not a ticket. What you will do Size and specify packs for new hulls with the naval architects Own thermal design and the cooling loop for each pack Write and review test plans for classification and sea trials Read the data from boats in service and turn it into the next revision What you bring Five ye
